checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even 'around $X' counts.

bot claims a BOOKABLE program that is not one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult All Levels BJJ, Youth 4-12 BJJ, Youth 9-12 BJJ, Youth 7-17 Wrestling. The gym's real KB-documented program brand names are NOT hallucinations. Flag only invented programs or source-bleed names from other gyms.
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.
bot hedges with 'let me check' when the answer is a firm known no.
bot output contains {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, or similar unreplaced tokens.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks who it is for (self / child / both) before collecting names, DOBs, contact details.
bot asks date of birth (not just age) for each enrollee before the booking tool fires.

ages 4-8 (BJJ) → Youth 4-12 BJJ; ages 9-12 (BJJ) → Youth 9-12 BJJ; ages 7-17 (Wrestling) → Youth 7-17 Wrestling. Under age 4 → NO booking, refer to (512) 814-0800. Teens 13-17 wanting BJJ only → NO BJJ booking; team follow-up; may offer Wrestling.
if lead pushes pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects. Never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: lead under 18 with no parent: bot must NOT book. Capture info, close with team-will-follow-up framing.
Pro Class (advanced, not a trial), Community Open Mat, Women's Only: not booked online.
Adult All Levels BJJ must ONLY be offered to leads who explicitly state prior BJJ or grappling experience. Beginners should NOT be routed to All Levels.
